mcnemar_em.rule: maximum of the three per-seed exact McNemar p-values

decision.label: Confirmation result (pre-registered, section 5)
decision.rule: FAAR beat the gated visual repair only if the Holm-adjusted McNemar p is below 0.05 and the document-level interval lies above 0.

detectable.formula: n = (z(0.975)*sqrt(d) + z(0.8)*sqrt(d - delta^2))^2 / delta^2; d is disagreement rate
